## Who am I?

Begin with a private mind map of interests, strengths, influences, places, communities, things you want to improve, and the kind of person you want to become.

## What becomes public?

The full mind map is private by default. Choose only the parts that you are comfortable turning into a public or professional identity.

## First NICE cycle

Use the [NICE Design Process](../resources/nice-design-process.qmd) to identify what a personal identity needs to communicate before designing anything.
